title: Printer Scheduling
source_topic: ICPC / The 2016 ACM - Asia Nha Trang Regional Contest
statement: Up to 200 files, each with a page count, a release time and a deadline, must be printed on m identical printers; printing may be interrupted and resumed on any printer, but a file may occupy only one printer at a time and each printer prints one page at a time. The task is to decide feasibility and, when feasible, emit an explicit schedule.
